claimBoundary: This profile qualifies a package-only complete-input baseline grayscale JPEG path: 8-bit SOF0, one 1x1 component, one sequential Huffman scan, 8-bit DQT, optional DRI/RST markers and no DNL. It does not qualify color JPEG, progressive JPEG or a public backend.

The decoder owns no frame-sized coefficient surface. After immutable source facts are parsed, width*height output bytes plus one fixed 512-byte scratch backing are admitted before allocation. The scratch contains one quantized coefficient block, one natural-order quantization table and the 256-byte ISLOW workspace; ISLOW writes clipped rows directly into the caller-admitted final raster, so there is no intermediate block-raster payload.

Generated geometry, pattern, quality and restart cases plus the retained grayscale fixture must match pinned libjpeg-turbo djpeg -grayscale -dct int byte-for-byte. The exact operation charge must succeed and charge-1 must fail before output/scratch allocation for every case.

The entropy reader is intentionally correctness-first: canonical Huffman decode has no lookahead table, stuffed FF data is recognized after any run of FF fill bytes, restart markers are sequence-checked, DC predictors reset at restart boundaries and residual entropy pad bits must be all ones. No observed pixel delta is converted into a tolerance.
